The following MIT-licensed packages do not ship a standalone license file
in their pinned npm archives. Original README attribution is copied under
dist/licenses, and source headers are retained in the browser bundle.

bezier-js 6.1.4: A javascript Bezier curve library by Pomax.
Source package: https://github.com/Pomax/bezierjs
Its source header and package metadata declare the MIT license.

javascript-natural-sort 0.7.1: Natural Sort algorithm for Javascript.
Author: Jim Palmer (based on chunking idea from Dave Koelle).
Source package: https://github.com/overset/javascript-natural-sort
Its source header and package metadata declare the MIT license.

seedrandom 3.0.5: Copyright 2019 David Bau.
Source package: https://github.com/davidbau/seedrandom
The full MIT text is also retained in its copied README and bundle source.
